svg.text: Zenith / Cursor concept: the Meridian set
Proposal, not running UI · 12 shapes on a 24-unit grid with rounded joins and a soft shadow · Light and Dark variants · rendered at 24, 32 and 48 px for 100–200% scaling
At actual size: 24 px (100%) and 48 px (200%) on the dark wallpaper, a cream light window and a dark window
Today there is one 12 × 19 px arrow with hard pixel edges.
The set adds text, link, busy, working, blocked, move,
four resize directions and a precise crosshair.
Drawn as vectors, rasterized at 24, 32 and 48 px with
antialiasing, so 125–200% scaling stays sharp. The
virtio-gpu hardware cursor gets the same 64 px image.
Text fields, links, window edges and corners, busy apps
(an accent arc turns) and refused drops. Meridian picks
Light or Dark and the size under Style › Cursor.
